name: MastermindEval
description: MastermindEval is a scalable and interpretable deductive reasoning benchmark inspired by the board game Mastermind. It supports agentic evaluation where models autonomously play the game and deductive reasoning evaluation where models infer a unique valid code from a given game state.
reputation: A new deductive reasoning benchmark that is still emerging and has limited community adoption so far.
notes: Benchmark inspired by Mastermind game; evaluates deductive reasoning and agentic gameplay; highlights difficulty even on easy instances and scalability for future models.
